subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the existing stale heartbeat fix, authorize a fresh narrow replacement, or keep waiting on the open fork PR?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the fix shape is clear, but the target PR was closed and the only open linked PR is a conflicting fork branch that maintainers cannot modify.

options.title: Authorize a fresh replacement
options.body: Create a new narrow OpenClaw PR from current main that preserves custom heartbeat prompts and covers the default/internal prompt paths.

options.title: Adopt the old fix
options.body: A maintainer can manually port the focused part of the closed target PR or open fork PR onto current main.

options.title: Wait for the fork PR
options.body: Keep this issue open until the fork author rebases, adds proof, and provides a clean merge path.

recommendation.title: Authorize a fresh replacement
recommendation.body: Create a new narrow OpenClaw PR from current main that preserves custom heartbeat prompts and covers the default/internal prompt paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and release/history evidence put this person closest to the current heartbeat-runner state and adjacent prompt behavior.
